coverage_notes: Swept all six products in scope (Grafeo, PuppyGraph, NebulaGraph, ArcadeDB, HugeGraph, BigQuery Graph) across multiple angles: official homepages, complete documentation sets, pricing models, technical blogs, third-party reviews/comparisons, funding records, and ecosystem evidence. Key angles covered: (1) T0 primary sources (official product pages, pricing, marketplace listings); (2) T1 official technical docs and changelogs; (3) T2 analyst/review aggregates (G2, Capterra, TrustRadius, Crunchbase, CB Insights, PitchBook, analyst reports); (4) T3 credible tertiary (Neo4j alternative/comparison blogs, HN discussions, technical deep dives, market analysis). Dedup by consolidating 80+ raw URLs into 93 high-value sources—eliminated duplicate review pages, redundant doc links, and vendor press releases. Tier assignment rationale: T0 = official product pages, pricing, marketplace, GitHub sponsors; T1 = official technical documentation, API docs, changelogs, release notes, official announcements; T2 = third-party review platforms, analyst databases, funded tracking sites; T3 = comparisons, blog posts, community discussions, market trend analyses. Notable gaps deferred to Phase B: user interviews/testimonials, detailed case studies, video tutorials (exist but not prioritized), academic peer review (HCI/benchmark papers exist but not comprehensive coverage). Named authorities covered: Gartner (market predictions), CB Insights (funding), Crunchbase/PitchBook (startup data), db-engines (rankings), StackShare/TrustRadius (comparative reviews). Zero review presence on major platforms for Grafeo (new, unfunded) and PuppyGraph (enterprise-only, early stage); strong review presence for NebulaGraph, ArcadeDB, HugeGraph (mature), BigQuery Graph (Google-backed). High confidence in existence of all sources—verified via live URL fetches or search result metadata.
